text: Move core/history_io.py and history_store.py into a new tracemantle/history/ package, leaving re-export shims at the old paths, and move tests/test_history_{io,model,regression}.py into tests/history/; update the mypy files list and hatch packages.
assumptions: history_store.py is src/tracemantle/history_store.py; core/history_io.py is src/tracemantle/core/history_io.py
the module names inside the new package are the mover's choice, so only the package itself is named
the mypy files list (src/tracemantle, scripts) and hatch packages (src/tracemantle, src/skillcheck) already cover a new subpackage, so neither needs an edit to include it
